code:
def run_bell_experiment():
  qc = QuantumCircuit(2)
  qc.h(0); qc.cx(0, 1)
  qc.measure_all()
  sim = AerSimulator()
  result = sim.run(qc, shots=1024)
    .result()
  return result.get_counts()
caption: Three responsibilities glued into one function, with no way to change any of them independently.
